designationHistory.name: Flattery Rocks Reservation
designationHistory.indexText: Theodore Roosevelt signed Executive Order 703 reserving the small islands off the Washington coast between latitudes 48°02' and 48°23' North, including Flattery Rocks and Ozette Island, as a preserve and breeding ground for native birds and animals.
designationHistory.note: Same day T.R. signed Executive Orders 704 (Copalis Rock) and 705 (Quillayute Needles). Renamed Flattery Rocks National Wildlife Refuge by Proclamation 2416, dated July 25, 1940 (APP); the CCP gives July 30, 1940. Now inside Olympic National Park's boundary (Public Law 100-226, 1987, per CCP).
